description: Use this when the assignee is done with a thread, or a worker should release its claim. Requires auth. Same permission as updating thread labels. Inputs: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email), thread_id (required), assignee (optional). When assignee is set, the row is removed only if it is assigned to that handle or the claim has expired. An active claim or a plain assignment held by someone else returns HTTP 409 thread_claimed with assignee and claimed_until. Returns {assignment:null, released:true|false}. released is false when nothing is assigned. That call is idempotent and does not emit an event. A successful release emits thread.unassigned. Unknown thread returns HTTP 404 thread_not_found. Another account's inbox returns inbox_not_found. A bad assignee returns invalid_assignee.

assignee.description: When set, release only if the thread is assigned to this handle, or the claim has expired.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_unassign_thread
title: Release a thread assignment
